shortDescription: Dashboard home feed view with GitHub-style dark layout.
fullDescription: Renders the dashboard-home-feed view in its default state with a GitHub-inspired application header, repository sidebar, central feed composer, trending and recommended repository cards, and a right rail for event and changelog content. The view accepts serializable props for state, user name, search placeholder, and feed sections, while local presentational state keeps search fields, menu selections, and star actions interactive immediately after render.
